llm_response.reason: While the main page lists typical fashion items, both the contact and privacy policy pages are inaccessible, which is suspicious and fits the profile of a scam website. Legitimate e-commerce stores provide clear, accessible contact details and privacy info. The lack of company information and inability to reach customer support or verify privacy practices further suggests this site is deceptive. These features match points 4, 6, and 7 of the scam criteria.
